about: Terminal: a migrating control plane that never reported healthy. Not restored; names the pre-update dump, and the output ends with the one restore command.

body.output:
the new container was not running and healthy within 300s (state=running health=starting)
This release migrates the database, and its migration may have run, so the previous control plane was not put back: an older control plane never runs against a newer schema. The new one is left as it is.
To go back to 0.3.0, run this on this machine. It stops the control plane, loads the dump 20260925T100000Z-schema-80 taken before the update into Quasar's database, and starts 0.3.0 again; anything written since the dump is lost:
docker exec quasar-recovery quasar-recovery restore --dump 20260925T100000Z-schema-80 --to 0.3.0
